lastCompletedStory.title: Event every dispatch refusal and add a per-issue pending-guard

nextStoryContext: US-007 was the last remaining story in this PRD (US-001..US-007, all now passes:true): extended MetaLoopDispatchEventDetail (src/supervisor/events.ts) with a { skipped: true; reason: MetaLoopDispatchSkipReason } variant (no new WorkerEventKind added, per AC2), and made the 3 previously-silent skip paths in sidecar.ts emit it: handleBlockedCycleBoundary's plain in-flight branch (reason 'cycle-in-flight'), makeProductionMetaLoopDispatchFn's mergeWatchPresentFn branch ('merge-watch-present'), and its phase!=idle branch ('phase-not-idle') -- all three fire every tick they're hit, deliberately un-deduped (the story only asked for visibility, not rate-limiting). Separately, added DispatchClosureState.pendingIssueId (compared by issue-id value, not a boolean) to dispatchOrDrain and handlePendingTarget: setPhaseFn is still called on every dispatch attempt (so a legitimate mutex-busy plan-phase retry of the same still-open issue keeps working), but 'dispatched:true' only fires once per pending issue id, which is what eliminates the ~4.7s CAM-98 storm (mutex-busy's exitPhaseAfterPlan resets phase to idle before any PRD exists, so the same issue was re-selected and re-emitted every tick). The guard self-clears the moment a DIFFERENT issue id is selected -- no explicit reset hook exists or is needed. Updated 3 existing tests that previously asserted zero meta-loop-dispatch events for these scenarios (now assert exactly one skip event with the correct reason) and added a new 'per-issue pending-guard' describe block (repeat-dispatch dedup + different-issue-clears-guard + oracle). Raised 3 file-size ceilings this story legitimately grew (src/commands/sidecar.ts, src/supervisor/events.ts, test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts) with a dated _ref entry. PRD is now fully passes:true; the next cam-next invocation should run review to a terminal verdict (the supervisor decides PRD_COMPLETE / awaiting-operator autonomously, not this agent).
